visual.title: Subtract the lower curve
visual.caption: The shaded region is bounded above by y = x and below by y = x². Its area is the integral of the difference, not the difference of the two integrals taken separately.

predict.question: The area between y = x and y = x² on [0, 1] is:
predict.explain: Integrate the upper minus the lower: ∫₀¹ (x − x²) dx = 1/6. The curves meet at x = 0 and x = 1, so no split is needed.
